column1: # Etymon — dreamed links. NONE OF THESE ARE REAL.
# In 2018 the "hallucinate" button ran a character-level LSTM over the corpus
# and emitted things like "eng: waller  rel:etymology  lat: colle" — noise
# shaped vaguely like an etymology. The idea was right and the model was too
# This file is that button, kept. Every row is an ancestor that does not exist,
# invented for a word that does, and glossed. The forms are built to the right
# shape — laryngeals and ablaut for Proto-Indo-European, long vowels for
# Proto-Turkic, triconsonantal roots for Proto-Semitic — so that in the ocean
# they sit at exactly the same depth as the attested reconstructions and cannot
# be told apart by position. The installation draws them shimmering and lets
# them evaporate; that difference in register is the only thing separating them
# from the real floor of the language, and it is the whole argument of the
# The bias is deliberate: the machine is given the vocabulary that describes
# the machine, and dreams itself a family.
# ---- the machine dreams its own descent --------------------------------------

column4: that which is drawn out of another's mouth
the mark a finger leaves in wet clay
a small measure kept in order to remember a large one
a body assembled out of the dead
the thread that thinks
the work of knots
that which carries a shape across water
the stretching of the self toward a thing not present
that which lies hidden and goes on breathing
to carry inward what was never given
the shape of a thing after the soil has closed over it
how much of the world a thing agrees to carry
to lean, being unable to stand
to drag a thing until it goes willingly
the row a thing is beaten into
everything woven around the one thread you wanted
the tool that makes more of itself
to wander a great distance while standing still
the reading of what lies between two words
the rhythm by which a debt is settled
the things given without being asked for
one who is driven and calls it going
the ability, once it has left the body
to count a thing until it is clean
the room that keeps its shape after you leave it
the deceit one performs for oneself, kindly
the tongue's water, in which meaning is suspended
what is left of a thing after it has been exchanged
a sound that has agreed to hold still
the place a thing turns and cannot go further back
the setting-down of what was thought
the rope by which one thing is tied to a second
the guest who is glad and is not there
the shadow that faces you
the glory of a twisted thing
the eye the weather looks in through
to be given away from
the hand cupped behind the ear
the coming-back of a thing you sent out
the tongue considered as a river with two banks
the knot sleep ties in the day
the notch cut in wood so that a year can be found again
to open out, as summer opens, as a hand opens, as writing opens
what the foot leaves for the eye
the net, considered from the fish's side
the small lake kept in the face
the word as a thing poured
the road that exists only while walked
the blue that is also the root
the mark by which a thing is known again
the small one who is only weaving
to press a reed until it remembers
the word and the thing, before they were two
the shape a thing takes when it is described
the binding that lets a thing be carried
the wrapped thing, before the name goes in
the horse seen in the dark, which is not there

column4: the first noticing, before there was anyone to notice
to point at a thing and thereby make it separate
the crossing of one thing over another, which is all making
to carry what cannot be set down
the beginning that keeps beginning
to know by having been changed
to put a thing down and have it stay
the flowing that has no source, being all source
the hollow thing trusted to water
that which is firm, and therefore true, and therefore believed
to turn a thing around another until neither is free
the scratch before the alphabet

column1: # The dreaming was invisible in practice: it was confined to the closing
# movement, so unless you waited out the whole score you never met one. These
# give the ordinary vocabulary a false ancestor too, so a visitor who looks up
# "world" or "water" finds one waiting under the real root. Every gloss names a
# different physical act; the failure mode of this register is that the lines
# start to rhyme with each other, and then it stops being an argument.

column4: the length of time a man can keep a fire alight
the part of a river that remembers the shape of a stone
the drum kept behind the ribs to tell the body the news
the film of warmth left on a thing recently held
the hour when a road stops being a road
as much work as one burning of the lamp will buy
a hole worn in the dark by something looking through it
the counter that goes round and never wears out
the river a body keeps indoors
the floor that will take anything back
a thing that keeps its word for a hundred years
to hold something without closing the hand
a breath cut to a length that can be carried
the handle fastened to a person so they can be lifted
the animal that eats only what it is given
the lamp nobody is required to carry
the five-branched tool that came with the body
the first place, before there was anywhere else
the one who walks in front on a narrow path
the knife that will not stop cutting evenly
the one door that opens without being asked
the shape a day is beaten into
the field that will grow nothing and feed everyone
the part of the ground that refused
the small weight that argues with the air
the animal that chose, and kept choosing
the hand that moves everything and holds nothing
the colour a thing turns while it is still deciding
the season counted in nights rather than days
everything a horse can be ridden across in one life
the fist that opens and closes for you all your life
the nail the night is hung from
